review_comments.body: ** Major** · **Functional Correctness** · **Quick win** **Handle incompatible sampling parameters for the new default.** `_build_request` sends both `temperature` and `top_p` when both are set. Claude 3.x accepted that combination, but Claude 4.6 rejects it. Existing requests that set both now fail in both generation paths. Select one parameter for Claude 4.x requests. ([github.com](https://github.com/anthropics/skills/blob/main/skills/claude-api/shared/model-migration.md?utm_source=openai))

** Minor** · **Data Integrity & Integration** · **Quick win** **Use decimal token limits.** These entries advertise limits above Anthropic’s limits: 1,048,576 instead of 1,000,000 and 131,072 instead of 128,000 for Claude 4.6; Haiku similarly advertises 204,800 and 65,536 instead of 200,000 and 64,000. Requests sized from this metadata can be rejected. Use the decimal limits and update the assertions. ([raw.githubusercontent.com](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eosphoros-ai/DB-GPT/b3deffe61d3a3d94cea3ce887695a452d1977dae/packages/dbgpt-core/src/dbgpt/model/proxy/models_dev_catalog.json)) Also applies to: 370-371

** Major** · **Data Integrity & Integration** · **Heavy lift** **Do not advertise function calling without proxy support.** `_build_request` drops `ModelRequest.tools` and `tool_choice`, and the generation paths do not return `tool_calls`. Callers selecting these entries for function calling therefore cannot execute their tools. Implement the request and response conversion, or set `function_calling` to `False` until it is supported. Also applies to: 374-374

** Major** · **Functional Correctness** · **Quick win** **Make the constructor tests work without the optional SDK.** `anthropic` is only declared in the `proxy_anthropic` extra. A core test environment without that extra fails these constructor tests with `ValueError`. Provide the dependency in the test environment or isolate the import at the SDK boundary. ([raw.githubusercontent.com](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eosphoros-ai/DB-GPT/b3deffe61d3a3d94cea3ce887695a452d1977dae/packages/dbgpt-core/pyproject.toml))

📝 Summary
### Purpose and implementation This change fixes `ClaudeLLMClient` initialization by setting `_api_base` from the `api_base` argument or `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`, with `https://api.anthropic.com` as the fallback. It defaults the client to `claude-sonnet-4-6`. ### Scope The change updates the Claude proxy and the `ANTHROPIC_MODEL_VERSION` configuration fallback. It adds `DEFAULT_CLAUDE_MODEL` and registers Claude Opus 4.6, Sonnet 4.6, and Haiku 4.5 with model metadata. Existing Claude 3 registrations remain. Tests cover the default and explicit model, API-base selection, and selected registration metadata. ### Risks The client passes `proxies` to `AsyncAnthropic`. The supplied tests do not establish compatibility with SDK versions that may not accept that argument. The tests do not exercise a live API request. ### Verification The supplied test file contains four tests, but no test-run result was provided. Run the targeted tests with: ```bash pytest packages/dbgpt-core/src/dbgpt/model/proxy/tests/test_claude.py ``` The Claude proxy now defaults to Claude Sonnet 4.6. Its model catalog includes metadata for Claude Opus 4.6, Sonnet 4.6, and Haiku 4.5. Tests cover model defaults, API base selection, and registration metadata. **Changes: Claude proxy model configuration** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |:---|:---| |**Default model and API base selection**

The change is meant to make the Claude proxy work with a new default model, but generation can still fail on SDK client construction. Requests that set both sampling parameters also fail on the new default model. The new tests need the optional SDK installed, and the new catalog entries advertise capabilities and limits that do not match the proxy or Anthropic's documentation. These should be fixed or explicitly accepted before merging.
